summary: [Slack] authorization: OAuth 2.0: bot tokens (xoxb-) with granular scopes (chat:write, channels:history, users:read...); app-level tokens (xapp-, connections:write) only for Socket Mode; user tokens (xoxp-) for user-context ops like search. Request smallest scope (standing rule 1). Incoming webhooks are the dumb-pipe alternative (single channel, no reads).
